reason: I use a freelancer I already trust or a referral, and I answer for every dollar I spend. A new, unaudited platform where an AI scores the work and I pay in USDC on Solana is not something I can defend to my board.
objection: Can an AI judge really tell good work from bad for my taste and brand? And if it picks wrong, I have paid out money I can't explain to the people I report to. It's also unaudited, and I don't hold USDC.
would_change_my_mind: A referral from another organiser I know who has used it, plus a human reviewing the winner before payout, a card or invoice payment option, and an independent audit.
